results.title: 2026 Effectuation Conference
results.content: # 11th Effectuation Conference:. Building on ten years of lively and highly interactive gatherings, we invite you to join us for the 11th Effectuation Conference on November 15-17, 2026, hosted by the University of Antwerp (Antwerp, Belgium) and co-branded with ECSB. What are the most important open research questions for effectuation research over the next 25 years? Co-branded with ECSB and scheduled in tandem with the RENT Conference, the 2026 Effectuation Conference will take place in Antwerp, Belgium. In the tradition of Effectuation Conference in past years, the format will offer plenary sessions as well as small group research and practice “pods” where your submissions can be developed into full-fledged research articles and teaching materials. Information about lodging near the RENT conference or with conference rates available and specific information about transit and accomodations for Effectuation 2026 will be provided later. Registration fee (accepted authors) = 250 EUR; ECSB members enjoy a reduced rate of 220 EUR; doctoral students accepted to the Effectuation Doctoral Research Alliance  = 150 EUR.
